name: The Sea of Glomp
storyline: A fish’s life is disrupted when a strange, bat-like underwater creature steals its egg. With no guidance, the fish sets out across a vast and unusual ocean to retrieve it.
summary: Sea of Glomp is an adventure puzzle game set in a surreal underwater world. You play as a fish on a mission to recover a stolen egg, journeying through diverse and unusual regions of the sea. The game emphasizes open-ended exploration, with no tutorials or direct instructions provided. Progress is achieved through experimentation and interaction with the environment. With a focus on discovery and non-linear gameplay, Sea of Glomp challenges players to navigate its expansive world and uncover its mechanics independently.
